caption: The image shows an oval-shaped plate with a decorative, lattice-like rim and a central scene. The plate is primarily composed of varying shades of gray, suggesting it is photographed in black and white. Along the rim, there is an intricate woven or braided pattern interspersed with floral or leaf motifs. The central image on the plate depicts a natural landscape with large, rounded hills or cliffs in the background, interspersed with clusterings of trees, and a body of water extending across the foreground. On the water, there are several boats or ships, including a prominent two-masted sailing vessel with furled sails and an apparent steam paddle at the side, positioned closer to the viewer. Farther in the background, smaller ships with thinner masts and what appear to be plumes of smoke suggestive of steamships are visible. The overall composition is centered within the plate, bordered by the ornate edge. The scene is monochromatic due to the photographic process.
title: Platter - "Hudson River"
